# Dwarves
## General Information
Dwarves are physically smaller than most other species, so they're [color=palevioletred]slowed more when dragging objects[/color] and are [color=palevioletred]easier to drag themselves[/color].
Their hardy digestive systems are more resistant to the effects of alcohol, and they can even [color=lightgreen]heal minor injuries[/color] by [color=lightgreen]drinking[/color].
They tend to be fond of food, and can [color=lightgreen]digest five reagents[/color] at once, where other species generally process three.
